hero.intro: Kado is a free, open-source tool for organizing secret gift exchanges among friends, family, or colleagues.
hero.principles: No account required. No ads. No tracking. Just what you need.

features.openSourceDesc: Kado is free software. Inspect it, modify it, or self-host it.
features.anonymousDesc: No identifying information required. Participate under any name you choose.
features.noAdsDesc: No tracking cookies, no ad networks, no data reselling.

cta.organizerTitle: I want to organize a gift draw
cta.organizerDesc: Create an exchange, add participants, and run the draw. Each participant will receive a unique link to share via the communication channel of your choice.
cta.participantTitle: I received a link to participate
cta.participantDesc: The organizer sent you a unique link — by email, text, or otherwise. Use that link directly: no account, no password required.
cta.participantHint: Didn't receive a link? Contact the person organizing the draw.

support.text: Kado is free and will always be.
support.subtext: If you'd like to support the project and help cover hosting costs, any contribution is warmly appreciated!
